|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E2 of [[Physical Choke (V)]] (version 3 of 3). The image here is the slip on the Virtual Set 23 release sheet with errata (Set-23-Plus-Errata.pdf) (PDF created 2 August 2024), cut unchanged from page 3. This is the current text. Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source. Every published image or slip that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 12 November 2026). A slip on a Players Committee release sheet and the PC card image are separate publications, so each is its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: “a change is a change”).
* '''Original''' ([[Physical Choke (V)]]): the card image at official release (20 July 2024)<ref name="ht-335d47f">Players Committee card image, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/335d47f6b929debedbac9376b863af4442469f36/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Dark/large/physicalchoke.gif as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (served at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual23-Dark/large/physicalchoke.gif res.starwarsccg.org]) in commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/335d47f6b929debedbac9376b863af4442469f36 335d47f] “Set 23 new images”, 20 July 2024.</ref> prints: “USED: Take into hand from Reserve Deck and reshuffle (or place in owner’s Used Pile) Deactivated Hyperdrive or an Admiral’s Order. LOST: During battle, if Vader present with two opponent’s characters of ability < 4, add one battle destiny. If any are Rebel troopers, choose one to be ‘choked’ (lost).”<ref name="cj-753083f">Dating evidence only: the PC card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/753083f swccg-card-json commit 753083f] “Set 23” (21 July 2024) first gave the card this wording.</ref> The card image prints no errata mark.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Physical Choke (V) (Errata)]]): the errata card image (23 July 2024, 3 days after release)<ref name="ht-d6a6c83">Players Committee card image, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/d6a6c8357ee1271111a23c1a199474dae7c25313/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Dark/large/physicalchoke.gif as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (served at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual23-Dark/large/physicalchoke.gif res.starwarsccg.org]) in commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/d6a6c8357ee1271111a23c1a199474dae7c25313 d6a6c83] “PhysChokeV and ERFv fixes”, 23 July 2024, 3 days after release.</ref> prints: “USED: Take into hand from Reserve Deck and reshuffle (or place in owner’s Used Pile) Deactivated Hyperdrive or an Admiral’s Order. LOST: During battle, if Vader present with two opponent’s characters of ability < 4, add one battle destiny. If any are Rebel troopers, choose one to be ‘choked’ (lost).” '''What changed:''' The words are unchanged. The first image printed the title with a uniqueness dot (“•”); the re-made image drops the dot, so the card is no longer unique as printed (the PC card data always had it without the dot). It is a version of its own because the PC published a visibly different card image (Bill, 12 November 2026: every visible change on a PC image is its own version). The card image prints no errata mark.

* '''PC-E2''' (this page): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 23 release sheet with errata (Set-23-Plus-Errata.pdf)<ref name="sheet23-20240802">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-23-Plus-Errata.pdf Virtual Set 23 release sheet with errata] (PDF, 9 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, July 2024”; file created 2 August 2024). Released with [[Virtual Set 23]] (22 July 2024); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 3, file created 2 August 2024: “USED: Take into hand from Reserve Deck and reshuffle (or place in owner's Used Pile) Deactivated Hyperdrive or an Admiral's Order. LOST: During battle, if Vader present with two opponent's characters of ability < 4, add one battle destiny. If any are Rebel troopers, choose one to be 'choked' (lost).” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Physical Choke (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1). The sheet prints a partial slip under the label “Physical Choke”: the lower part of the PC card image of [[Physical Choke (V) (Errata)]] (published 24 July 2024) — the bars and game-text box down to the lower-left name — pixel for pixel the same, to be laid over the card named in its lower-left corner ([[Physical Choke]]). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 2 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
